newsitem.title: USA: Zenith cuts prices on cable modems.
newsitem.headline: Zenith cuts prices on cable modems.

text.p: Zenith Electronics Corp said Monday it enhanced the software and cut prices for its series of cable modems.

In a statement issued from the National Cable Television Association convention in New Orleans, Zenith said its new MetroAcess System Release 10 software adjusts transmission speeds and filters out certain types of network traffic, among other things.
Glenview, Ill-based Zenith said it is offering its HomeWorks Universal two-way cable modems for under $300.
"Our new pricing reflects efficiencies from higher production volumes," said William Luehrs, president of Zenith Network Systems.

List prices for all Zenith HomeWorks Universal cable modems, including those with the telco-return option, have been cut to $399 from $495. In quantities of 1,000 or more, the unit price is $299, the company said.
